headline: Texas Instruments internship listing includes analog functional coverage, random stimuli and chip-level timing checks
fact: A University of Pittsburgh recruiting job posting dated September 3 advertises a Texas Instruments Design Verification Engineering internship. The employer description includes SystemVerilog coverage for voltages, currents and real values alongside digital coverage, constrained-random analog stimulus and automatic result checking. It also assigns RTL and gate-level simulations with SDF for timing between analog and digital circuits, regression scripting, verification planning and improvements to verification methods.
